title: Integration Testing with WebApplicationFactory & Testcontainers
description: Test end-to-end ASP.NET Core API pipelines with WebApplicationFactory, spin up real vector databases via Testcontainers, and stub AI models using WireMock.Net.

data.text: The Role of Integration Testing in AI Applications

While unit tests verify isolated classes with mocked interfaces, Integration Tests verify that all pieces of your ASP.NET Core application work harmoniously together: middleware routing, JWT authentication, dependency injection lifetimes, database connection pooling, and real vector index queries. Using WebApplicationFactory and Testcontainers for .NET, you can spin up an in-memory test server and real containerized databases on the fly during test execution.
Spinning Up Real Vector Databases with Testcontainers for .NET

Instead of relying on fragile shared staging databases or in-memory mocks that don't support true vector math, Testcontainers manages lightweight Docker containers (such as Qdrant or PostgreSQL pgvector) automatically during the test fixture lifecycle.

data.text: Mocking Cloud LLM HTTP Traffic with WireMock.Net

To verify that your ASP.NET Core resilience policies (Polly retries, circuit breakers) respond correctly when Azure OpenAI returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests or 503 Service Unavailable, use WireMock.Net to simulate exact HTTP responses and headers locally without calling live cloud APIs.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: WebApplicationFactory<Program> hosts your entire ASP.NET Core pipeline in memory for testing
Testcontainers for .NET spins up real Qdrant, Redis, or PostgreSQL containers automatically during test runs
Stub external AI provider endpoints using WireMock.Net to test 429 throttling and retry policies
Verify that authentication, model binding, authorization, and error handling work together seamlessly
Clean up container fixtures with IAsyncLifetime to ensure zero orphaned Docker containers in CI
data.takeaway: Integration testing bridges the gap between unit mocks and production reality. Combining WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, and WireMock.Net enables deterministic full-stack verification.
